item.title: UMass Dartmouth football player killed in stabbing, student charged with murder
item.description: A UMass Dartmouth football player was killed in a stabbing in Providence and another student has been charged with murder.

item.title: Ukraine launches 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds fired at Moscow
item.description: Across the wider Moscow region, the attack killed two people and wounded 20, a local official said Sunday.

item.title: Cassidy: Trump needs to be "radically honest" on vaccines amid measles outbreak
item.description: GOP Sen. Bill Cassidy of Louisiana urged the president to be "radically honest" when he's speaking about vaccines, as the U.S. this year has recorded the most measles cases in more than three decades.

item.title: Sen. Bill Cassidy says "having measles is not a kind of victimless experience"
item.description: Republican Sen. Bill Cassidy, who is a licensed medical doctor, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that as the measles epidemic grows, "having measles is not a kind of victimless experience — it's a little bit like drunk driving. You know, you can drink and get drunk, but if you drive, you're going to hurt other people."

item.title: 18 suspects in killing of Haiti's president being extradited to Florida for trial
item.description: Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse​ were awaiting extradition to the U.S. on Sunday.

item.title: Trump to meet Mamdani tomorrow in New York City
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and President Trump have met at least twice since Mamdani was elected last year.

item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng, ahead of the planned summit between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping this week.

item.title: Trump says proposed arch will also be a "top grade Military Complex"
item.description: President Trump said that he has agreed to convert plans for a massive triumphal arch into a "top grade Military Complex," equipped with snipers and drone storage.

item.title: Trump says proposed 250-foot arch will be used as military complex
item.description: President Trump posted on social media early Sunday that his proposed 250-foot arch near Arlington National Cemetery will be used as a military complex, saying there will "large numbers of drones, plus Snipers, on both the roof and plaza areas, and additionally have and hold large quantities of sniper ammunition in storage."

item.title: 9/20: Face The Nation
item.description: This week on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," President Trump faces a pivotal week ahead in foreign policy as the House is recessed until after the midterm elections. Reps. Ro Khanna and Maria Elvira Salazar join, as well as Sen. Bill Cassidy.

item.title: Retiring Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III: "You can run from history, but you can't hide"
item.description: In 2019, Bunch became both the first historian and the first African American to serve as Secretary of the Smithsonian Institution. As he prepares to retire, he talks about the museums' mission to protect history, and give America a full picture of itself.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico staffers barred from White House after Trump ban
item.description: President Trump said Friday that three outlets would be banned from the White House, "effective immediately."

item.title: Pentagon releases UFO files with documents on secretive military program
item.description: The Pentagon on Friday released a new group of files about unidentified anomalous phenomena, or UAP or UFOs, including a batch of documents regarding a mysterious military program studying aerospace threats.

item.title: FAA says Trump arch will not interfere with D.C. airport flight path
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration approved President Trump's plans for a triumphal arch across the Potomac River from Washington, D.C.

item.title: Patrick Clancy's wife: "I don't understand how the story's been so twisted"
item.description: Ross Douthat's interview with Patrick Clancy and his wife, Dr. Rachel Danis, airs Sunday on 60 Minutes.

item.title: The Uplift: Dolly Parton
item.description: Dolly Parton was known for her music, acting, glitz and glam – but there is more to the star that meets the eye. We celebrate Dolly's legacy and philanthropy and her alter-ego, "The Book Lady."

item.description: On this "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" broadcast, Energy Secretary Chris Wright and Rep. Jason Crow join Margaret Brennan.

item.title: The Uplift: John Legend
item.description: We hear from John Legend about his newest project – and the legendary place he recorded it. Plus, two inspiring stories from David Begnaud.

item.title: The Uplift: The Shatners
item.description: William Sahtner and his daughter Melanie Shatner-Gretsch open up about their individual cancer battles that led to a strengthened bond between them. Plus, more heartwarming news

item.title: The Uplift: Travel buddies
item.description: An unlikely friendship forms between two New Yorkers who meet on a commuter train – and find themselves traveling to a tropical island together. Plus, more heartwarming news.

item.title: The Uplift: Hot Ones
item.description: Vladimir Duthiers meets Sean Evans, host of "Hot Ones," the online show that has celebrities answer questions while attempting to eat chicken wings that get progressively spicier. Can Vlad stand the heat?

item.title: The Uplift: Weaving American history
item.description: We travel to South Boston, Virginia, where they are weaving pieces of American history every day at a patriotic flag factory. Plus, David Begnaud shares three heartwarming stories sent to him by viewers.

item.title: The Uplift: Graduates share the stage
item.description: A Maryland mom has an extra reason to be proud on her son's graduation day. She gets to cross the stage and receive her diploma alongside him. Plus, Spelman College, an HBCU in Atlanta, celebrates seven women at the top of the 2026 graduating class.

item.title: The Uplift: Peanut the puppy
item.description: A rescue dog at Pasadena Humane in Los Angeles has gone viral – and the puppy has inspired thousands of donations. Plus, David Begnaud introduces us to a young woman who shares how two high school teachers who made a life-changing impact on her as a teen.

item.title: The Uplift: An adoption story
item.description: A young boy, who showed to the hospital for a procedure alone, gets a happy ending when his doctor adopts him – and helps his siblings too. Plus, more heartwarming news.

item.title: The Uplift: Surfing lessons
item.description: A Hawaii man gathers his group of friends to teach surfing lessons to strangers – and there is a powerful reason why they don't charge a cent. Plus, more heartwarming news.
